title: Defus: open scans of printed Hebrew books
summary: Open scans of printed Hebrew books and Judaica, 1469–1920, gathered from the libraries that hold them.
method: Harvested from library catalogues (HathiTrust, Internet Archive, Munich, Frankfurt and others); editions grouped into works. The scans stay with the libraries; rights are per copy.
cite: Defus: open scans of printed Hebrew books and Judaica, ed. Ezra Brand. Open Seforim
